Band condition: ML(v) = max_{t in [0,1]} min_i ||v_i t|| <= 2/(2n+1), where ||x|| = min_{m in Z} |x - m|.

A seed certificate is a set S with 1 <= |S| <= 2 satisfying: (1) no coefficient-two relation supported in S, and (2) every j outside S has a coefficient-two relation supported in S union {j} with c_j != 0.
